The Mac photos show 5 more genuinely distinct Epernay 'Serie 2009' vitolas beyond that list, all confirmed real products across multiple retailers. Note the line's own naming is inconsistently gendered in French across retailers (La Vie / Le Elegance / Le Grande) - not a research error, just how Illusione/retailers spell it.
